name: RapidOCR
summary: Use when the user needs to extract text from an image, PDF-scan, screenshot, or picture — OCR / 图片文字识别 / 扫描件转文字 / 截图识字 / 抠图文字. Triggered on tasks like 识别图片文字、把图片转成文本、截图里的字抄出来、扫描件PDF抢救。Chinese-first OCR powered by RapidOCR (ONNX Runtime); no API key needed, works offline, auto-installs dependencies on first use.
